title: Ulyana and the Veil
premise: When the border wards of Thornfell collapse on the night the stars vanish, guild smuggler Ulyana Sterling discovers the wards were never meant to keep enemies out — they were keeping a bound king's curse asleep. The 'thing wearing the crown' is a veil-born parasite that has ruled through three generations of monarchs, and it needs the fallen stars' light to finish unbinding itself. Hunted by the guild he betrayed and courted by rebels who want him as a weapon, Ulyana must trace his dead mother's hidden role in the original binding, choose between loyalty to the only family he's known and the truth that damns them, and finally rebind the king at the cost of the veil — and his own place in either world.
about_author: Paloma Nystrom is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent six years mapping mountain passes across northern Scandinavia before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about borders, both drawn on maps and drawn in blood, from a cabin she refuses to geotag.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Running a final smuggling route through Thornfell, Ulyana notices the stars flicker out one by one just as the border wards shatter like glass overhead. He shelters a wounded ward-keeper named Sera who whispers that the king did this. Emotional beat: dread and disorientation as his reliable world breaks.

chapters.title: What the Guild Keeps in Its Cellars
chapters.summary: Ulyana returns to the guildhall seeking answers; Guildmaster Corvane orders all routes sealed and forbids anyone from approaching the capital. Ulyana finds a locked vault bearing his mother's sigil. Emotional beat: first crack of doubt about the family that raised him.

chapters.title: Sera's Bargain
chapters.summary: Sera recovers and reveals the wards were anchored by royal bloodline magic — meaning someone inside the palace dropped them deliberately. She offers Ulyana safe passage to the capital if he helps her reach the rebel cell there. Emotional beat: wary alliance born of mutual need.

chapters.title: Corvane's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ulyana secretly copies the guild's oldest ledger and finds payments spanning sixty years from the crown to the guild — hush money for routes that bypass the wards. His loyalty wavers; Corvane catches him and gives him a choice: forget it or be cast out. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Road Below the Wards
chapters.summary: Traveling chapter told through Ulyana's expert navigation of smuggler tunnels while the land above grows starless and cold. Refugees speak of the king walking the walls at night, talking to no one. Emotional beat: mounting unease; the mountains themselves feel watched.

chapters.title: The Rebel Cell
chapters.summary: In the capital's undercity, Ulyana meets the rebellion's leader, Dain Ashvale, who wants Ulyana's knowledge of the palace's forgotten ways. Dain reveals the king hasn't been seen truly awake in months. Emotional beat: belonging offered too easily — Ulyana distrusts how well it fits.

chapters.title: A Glimpse Through the Veil
chapters.summary: During an infiltration rehearsal, Ulyana touches an old ward-stone and sees visions: his mother, young, standing beside a dying queen, sealing something into a newborn prince. Emotional beat: grief and revelation colliding — his inheritance is the binding itself.

chapters.title: Mother's Letters
chapters.summary: Following his mother's ciphered letters hidden along her old routes, Ulyana learns she was the last Binder and faked her death to hide him from the crown. The parasite — the Veil — feeds on starlight and wears kings like masks. Emotional beat: mourning a mother he now truly meets for the first time.

chapters.title: Dain's True Price
chapters.summary: Ulyana discovers Dain plans not to free the king but to kill him and seize power during the chaos, using Ulyana as the assassin's key. Sera defends Dain; Ulyana walks out. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth made literal — every ally wants something.

chapters.title: Taken by the Crown
chapters.summary: Royal guards capture Ulyana — tipped off, he realizes, by Corvane trading him for the guild's survival. In the palace dungeon he hears the king weeping through the walls at night. Emotional beat: despair curdling into a terrible curiosity about the man behind the mask.

chapters.title: The King in the Mirror Room
chapters.summary: Brought before King Aldric, Ulyana sees the Veil slip: the king's reflection moves independently, pleading. Aldric, in lucid moments, begs Ulyana to finish what his mother started before the next new moon. Emotional beat: compassion for the enemy — the king is a prisoner too.

chapters.title: Terms of a Dying Man
chapters.summary: Aldric explains the binding requires a Binder of Sterling blood and a willing vessel; each rebinding has cost a life. He shows Ulyana the observatory where the stars are being devoured. Emotional beat: the weight of inheritance — Ulyana may be the price.

chapters.title: Escape Across the Rooftops
chapters.summary: Using smuggler routes only he knows, Ulyana escapes with Aldric's signet ring and a map to the original binding site beneath Thornfell. The Veil, aware now, sends hunters. Emotional beat: exhilaration shadowed by pursuit — he is carrying the cure and the bait.

chapters.title: Sera at the Crossroads
chapters.summary: Sera intercepts Ulyana, torn between Dain's plot and the truth Ulyana carries. She chooses to come with him, betraying the rebellion. Emotional beat: fragile trust rebuilt through shared defiance.

chapters.title: Corvane's Confession
chapters.summary: Cornered by guild hunters, Ulyana confronts Corvane, who admits the guild was founded by Binders to guard the king's secret and has grown fat and cowardly. He lets Ulyana pass — and pays for it with his life when the Veil's hunters arrive. Emotional beat: grief for a flawed father figure.

chapters.title: Into the Deep Roads
chapters.summary: Ulyana and Sera descend into the ancient binding vault beneath Thornfell, navigating collapsing passages as the last stars die overhead. They find his mother's final workbench and an unfinished second binding — one requiring no death. Emotional beat: hope kindled in darkness.

chapters.title: The Unfinished Rite
chapters.summary: Deciphering his mother's notes, Ulyana learns the merciful binding needs a living anchor freely given — but the anchor will be bound inside the veil's edge forever, neither alive nor dead. Sera volunteers; Ulyana refuses to let her. Emotional beat: love versus sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Veil Comes for Them
chapters.summary: The parasite, wearing the bodies of hunters and half the court, floods the deep roads. Dain arrives with rebels intending to kill the king mid-rite and claim the throne. Three-way standoff in the vault. Emotional beat: terror and clarity — everyone's agendas converge.

chapters.title: Climax: The Rebinding
chapters.summary: Amid battle, Ulyana begins the rite as the Veil tears free of Aldric and offers Ulyana everything he's ever wanted — belonging, his mother back, the guild restored — if he becomes its new vessel instead. Emotional beat: temptation at its most intimate.

chapters.title: The Anchor
chapters.summary: Ulyana refuses the Veil's bargain and binds it using himself as the living anchor, stepping halfway into the veil's edge. Sera and a freed Aldric complete the circuit; the stars reignite. Emotional beat: transcendence through self-sacrifice.

chapters.title: Halfway Between
chapters.summary: Ulyana exists at the veil's threshold, able to return briefly at each new moon. Aldric, restored, dissolves the corrupt court; Sera rebuilds the guild as guardians rather than smugglers. Emotional beat: bittersweet peace — victory that costs presence.

chapters.title: The New Moon Door
chapters.summary: On the first new moon after the binding, Ulyana steps back through into Thornfell under returned starlight, greeted by Sera. He takes up his mother's mantle as the guild's first true Binder in a generation. Emotional beat: belonging finally earned, on his own terms.
